exception.justification: Justified: Pure formatting of a closed public refusal inherits its enclosing proof comparison and cannot recurse into observation.

review.item_premise: Pure successor operation over public retained structure and explicitly supplied complete opening or approval evidence; it neither reads holder state nor grants authenticated inclusion. Exact public values and closed refusals may be recorded.
